# ui::MessageBoxOptions

Header: `winui/ui/MessageBox.hpp`.

What [ui::message_box()](namespace-ui.md#message_box) shows. [Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) it with designated initializers.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The box's window title. Empty: the program's file name. |
| `heading` | `std::string` |  | A short line in large text above `text`, the question or the problem in a few words. Empty: none. |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | The message. [Line](../controls/shapes.md#uiline) breaks are kept. |
| `buttons` | `MessageBoxButtons` | `MessageBoxButtons::Ok` | The buttons offered. |
| `icon` | `MessageBoxIcon` | `MessageBoxIcon::None` | The icon beside the text. |
